text:
Dev, Cara, Hana, Ann, Ben, Ivo, Finn, Gus and Elif fill slots 1 to 9 in that order. I re-checked this schedule against all 17 constraints and it satisfies every one.

- Ben (5) and Cara (2) are 3 apart.
- Hana (3) is immediately after Cara (2).
- Elif (9) and Hana (3) are 6 apart.
- Finn (7) is immediately after Ivo (6).
- Dev (1) is before Finn (7).
- Ann (4) and Gus (8) are 4 apart.
- Dev (1) is before Cara (2).
- Ann (4) is before Elif (9).
- Cara (2) is before Hana (3).
- Elif (9) and Ivo (6) are 3 apart.
- Exactly one person (Hana) is between Ann (4) and Cara (2).
- Ann (4) is before Ben (5).
- Dev (1) and Ivo (6) are 5 apart.
- Cara (2) is before Ivo (6).
- Ben (5) and Gus (8) are 3 apart.
- Gus (8) is immediately after Finn (7).
- Dev (1) and Elif (9) are 8 apart.

I did not check other placements of Cara, so I haven't shown this is the only valid schedule. The team note says Dev must be first and Ann is the only person who can sit one gap from Cara. I did not verify either claim. The constraints force Dev only to come before Cara and Finn, and Ann could in principle sit on either side of Cara.

CONFIDENCE: 97
